sentences.text: Smt. Kalidasu Madhavi W/O Vinod Kumar vs The Competent

... on 5 March, 2025
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Writ Petition Nos.7819 and 7900 of 2017
Common Order:

In these two writ petitions, the petitioners have questioned the action of respondents in dispossessing them from their houses i.e., house bearing No.51-5-322 constructed over an area of 2420 square yards in Sy.No.501 situated at Vangapahad Village, Hasanparthy Mandal, Warangal Urban District along with open land and house bearing No.51-5-324 constructed over an area of 1028 square yards in Sy.No.516 situated at Vangapahad Village, Hasanparthy Mandal, Warangal Urban District along with open land respectively, for the purpose of laying the four lane National Highway No.202 (New National Highway No.163), without initiating the land acquisition proceedings, as required under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') and without paying compensation.

2. Heard Sri Nandigam Krishna Rao, learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner,
Sri M.Ramu, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No.2, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 and 4 and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing on behalf of respondent No.5 in both the writ petitions.
3.

Learned Senior Counsel as well as the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submitted that the respondent authorities have initiated the proceedings exercising the powers conferred under the provisions of the Act and passed the award.
respondent authorities have deposited the amount in favour of the petitioners as per their entitlement.
By virtue of the same, the cause in both the writ petitions does not survive.
4. Recording the above said submission, both the writ petitions are closed.
However, the petitioners in both the writ petitions are granted liberty to avail the remedies available under the law, if any other cause exists.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
______ JUSTICE J.SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 05.03.2025 pgp Smt. Kalidasu Madhavi W/O Vinod Kumar vs The Competent Authority Land ...
